job_description_text:
Job Description – Full Stack Developer (3–6 Years Experience)

Position: Full Stack Developer
Experience: 3–6 Years
Location: Bengaluru / Chennai / Hyderabad (Hybrid)
Employment Type: Full-Time

Job Summary

We are seeking a skilled Full Stack Developer with 3–6 years of experience in designing, developing, and deploying scalable web applications. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in both frontend and backend development and hands-on experience with at least one public cloud platform such as Amazon Web Services (AWS).

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, test, and maintain full-stack web applications.
Build responsive and user-friendly frontend interfaces.
Develop robust backend APIs and microservices.
Integrate applications with databases, third-party services, and cloud infrastructure.
Deploy and manage applications on AWS cloud environments.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and QA teams.
Optimize application performance, scalability, and security.
Participate in code reviews and follow software development best practices.
Troubleshoot and resolve production issues.
Required Skills
Frontend
JavaScript, TypeScript
React.js or Angular
HTML5, CSS3
Responsive UI Development
Backend
Node.js / Express.js
RESTful APIs
Microservices Architecture
Database
PostgreSQL, MySQL, or MongoDB
Database Design and Query Optimization
Cloud & DevOps
AWS (EC2, S3, RDS, Lambda, IAM)
Docker
CI/CD Pipelines
Git/GitHub
Qualifications
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or related field.
3–6 years of professional software development experience.
Experience developing and deploying enterprise-grade applications.
Strong understanding of software design principles and system architecture.
Excellent problem-solving and communication skills.
Preferred Skills
Kubernetes
Serverless Architecture
Terraform or CloudFormation
Agile/Scrum methodologies
Unit Testing and Automation Frameworks
Nice to Have
Experience with event-driven architectures.
Knowledge of application monitoring tools.
Exposure to AI/ML service integrations.
Experience working in cloud-native environments.
Keywords for Resume Screening
